description: This file implements auto-completion logic for commands in the Mattermost server, including suggestion generation, argument parsing, and dynamic list fetching, with support for built-in and external data sources.

classes.name: AutocompleteDynamicArgProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing dynamic auto-complete list items for built-in commands.

methods.name: GetSuggestions
methods.description: Returns autocomplete suggestions based on user input and command list.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Internal recursive function to generate suggestions based on current input and command structure.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses command arguments, handling optional and required arguments recursively.

methods.name: parseArgument
methods.description: Parses individual argument, including named, text, static list, and dynamic list arguments.

methods.name: parseInputTextArgument
methods.description: Parses text input arguments, supporting quoted multi-word inputs.

methods.name: parseStaticListArgument
methods.description: Parses static list arguments for suggestions.

methods.name: getDynamicListArgument
methods.description: Fetches dynamic list items for suggestions, either built-in or via plugin request.

methods.name: getBuiltinDynamicListArgument
methods.description: Retrieves list items for built-in commands.

methods.name: parseListItems
methods.description: Converts list items into suggestions, handling partial input.
